$comment: StageBench demo v2: `node scripts/make.mjs --show shows/demo-v2-alla-turca.json`. Models play in the listed order (not a countdown). Ranks are computed at plan/compose time from src/data/runs.json, the gallery's combined leaderboard; never write them here. A model that can't be filmed yet (no run record or no stage-3 preview in this checkout) is a placeholder slot: its bars stay in the plan and compose fills them with a label card until it is recorded (README 'Placeholders'). previewBase "local" serves this checkout's public/ (scripts/lib/serve.mjs). Cut: 8-bar phrases from the A-minor theme's return (bar 129, with its one-beat pickup) to the end of the janissary march; the last model stops on the march's A-major cadence (bar 192, beat 1: lastBarBeats) and holds that chord (finalHold) instead of running into the coda. intro: the real Nord Stage 4 photo on black (assets/nord-stage-4-on-black.png, keyed by scripts/key-photo.mjs from the wustep.me photo), 2.5 s over silence, then a hard cut to the first model. endCard: the StageBench keyboard illustration from wustep.me (assets/stagebench-keyboard.svg, vector, drawn 640 px wide), then the title and the link fading in beneath it, 4 s. Card type and layout are house style in scripts/compose.mjs.
